name: Aethlon Medical, Inc.

growth.note: dosed first participant in the 3rd/final Phase 1 oncology dosing cohort (Australia); Hemopurifier has FDA Breakthrough Device Designation. Pending North Immunology merger would pivot pipeline to NOR-101 (atopic dermatitis bispecific).

catalysts.headline: Aethlon Medical and privately-held North Immunology announced a definitive all-stock merger plus a concurrent ~$180M private placement (incl. ~$34M note conversion); combined company to operate as North Immunology, trade as NRTX; legacy Aethlon holders get ~4.75% of combined co. plus a CVR tied to Hemopurifier proceeds; targets closing Q1 2027
